description: Emergency Medical Service (EMS) Incidents is published by County of Marin, CA. The ambulance-dispatch archive includes event timestamps, injury categories and generalized locations. Its stated coverage is Marin County, California, United States; March 2013 to September 2019. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License. Deprecated in December 2025; street locations are deliberately obscured. For simulation, it can inform emergency-response planning and comparisons of demand against available resources; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-jemss provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
